proof:
constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hg
    intro p q hpq
    exact (hg p).symm.trans ((congrArg g hpq).trans (hg q))
  · intro h
    classical
    let g : Obs → Action := fun o => if hp : ∃ p, obs p = o then f (Classical.choose hp) else default
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    intro p
    dsimp [g]
    split
    · next hp => exact h _ p (Classical.choose_spec hp)
    · next hp => exact False.elim (hp ⟨p, rfl⟩)
